❓ Why can't I decode the message?

Common causes:
• Secret key mismatch (check passphrase)
• Room noise or phones too far apart (bring phones within 50 cm)
• Audio compression (send WAV as 'Document' in WhatsApp to avoid compression)
• Microphone volume too low
